title: Roller Crusher
model_title: Double Roll Crusher (Toothed Rolls, Spring Relief)

introduction.definition: A double roll crusher has two rolls turning towards each other. Material is drawn into the gap (nip) between them and crushed by compression and, with toothed rolls, by shearing. One roll is held by springs so it can move back and let uncrushable objects through. The gap between the rolls sets the product size, and fines are low.
applications: Secondary crushing of soft-to-medium ores, salt, limestone
Producing a product with few fines
key_points: Low fines; reduction ratio about 3–4 : 1 for smooth rolls
introduction.summary: A roll crusher nips material between two counter-rotating rolls. Teeth grip and break it as it is drawn down through the gap, which sets the product size. One roll is spring-loaded so uncrushable tramp material can pass without damage.

working_principle.characteristic_curve: Nip condition: a lump is gripped only if the nip angle is below twice the friction angle; bigger rolls nip bigger lumps for the same gap.

wear.title: Roll wear pattern
wear.description: Feed tends to concentrate at the centre of the rolls, so the teeth wear fastest there (purple) and the rolls become "hollow" — the gap opens in the middle and the product coarsens. Spreading the feed across the full width (feeder width, chute design) and rebuilding or re-profiling the teeth keeps the gap even.

foundation: Mount on a massive reinforced-concrete foundation or steel structure designed for the crusher's dynamic loads (maker's load data); use anti-vibration mounts where specified.
Allow crane access and lay-down space for liner and wear-part changes.
alignment: Align motor and crusher sheaves or coupling; set V-belt tension to the maker's figure.
Set the closed-side setting (CSS) or gap with the maker's gauge/lead-ball method.
piping: Feed with a controlled feeder (choke or regulated feed as designed); avoid segregated or one-sided feed.
Fit a tramp-metal magnet or metal detector ahead of the crusher and dust extraction at transfer points.
Lubrication system: connect oil supply/return, cooler and filter; check flow and pressure switches.
commissioning: Check lubrication flows and temperatures before starting; run empty to check direction, vibration and current.
Introduce feed gradually; measure product size and adjust the setting; record power draw as a baseline.

routine.task: Check gap, spring tension and roll surface.

periodic.task: Measure roll wear across the width.

lubrication: Roll bearings and drive gears: lubricate to schedule.

symptoms: Gap opens in the centre, product coarse

safety: Guard the in-running nip; lock out before clearing; never feed by hand.

video_tutorials.title: Roller Crusher — Introduction

script.narration: This module introduces the Roller Crusher.
A double roll crusher has two rolls turning towards each other.
Material is drawn into the gap (nip) between them and crushed by compression and, with toothed rolls, by shearing.
One roll is held by springs so it can move back and let uncrushable objects through.
Typical applications include coal and coke crushing; secondary crushing of soft-to-medium ores, salt, limestone; producing a product with few fines.
The cutaway reveals the internal construction: Fixed Roll, Floating Roll (spring-loaded), Frame with Bearing Housings.
The exploded view separates every component so each one can be tapped for its function, material and failure modes.
Next, watch the operation tutorial to see how it works.

script.narration: How the Roller Crusher works.
Material from the feed hopper falls onto the rolls.
The two rolls turn towards each other and nip the lumps.
Lumps are crushed in the gap; the floating roll is held by springs.
Product falls from the bottom of the gap.
The flow overlay traces the liquid from suction to discharge.
Feed tends to concentrate at the centre of the rolls, so the teeth wear fastest there (purple) and the rolls become "hollow" — the gap opens in the middle and the product coarsens.

video_tutorials.title: Roller Crusher — Maintenance

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Roller Crusher.
Check gap, spring tension and roll surface.
Measure roll wear across the width.
Rebuild teeth/shell and replace bearings.
Watch for hollow (uneven) roll wear: gap opens in the centre, product coarse. Common cause: feed concentrated at the centre.
Watch for spring fatigue: gap opens under load. Common cause: fatigue, wrong pre-load.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
